MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY MARCH — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #6
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather and Climatic Conditions in Marine and Freshwater 3.3 Fishery by-products? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather and Climatic Conditions in Marine and Freshwater 3.3 Fishery by-products.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Weather and Climatic Conditions in Marine and Freshwater 3.3 Fishery by-products.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Weather and Climatic Conditions in Marine and Freshwater 3.3 Fishery by-products.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Weather and Climatic Conditions in Marine and Freshwater 3.3 Fishery by-products.

2. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Milk souring
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Paper burning to ash

3. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   D. Any substance that conducts electricity

4. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

5. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Producers
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Tertiary consumers
   D. Primary consumers only

6. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Only carbon dioxide

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Technologies and Innovation in Aquaculture 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Conservatio? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Technologies and Innovation in Aquaculture 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Conservatio.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Technologies and Innovation in Aquaculture 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Conservatio.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Technologies and Innovation in Aquaculture 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Conservatio.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Technologies and Innovation in Aquaculture 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Conservatio.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Reproduction? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Reproduction.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Reproduction.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Reproduction.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Reproduction.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Buoyancy, locomotion and movement in fishes? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Buoyancy, locomotion and movement in fishes.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Buoyancy, locomotion and movement in fishes.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Buoyancy, locomotion and movement in fishes.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Buoyancy, locomotion and movement in fishes.

10. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Movement of water only across a membrane
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. Heating until a solid melts

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Ecology and Ecosystems? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Ecology and Ecosystems.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Ecology and Ecosystems.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Ecology and Ecosystems.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Ecology and Ecosystems.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish feeds and feeding? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Fish feeds and feeding.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish feeds and feeding.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish feeds and feeding.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish feeds and feeding.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Marine Resource Utilisation 4.4 Blue Economy and Marine Entrepreneurship Page 12 and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Marine Resource Utilisation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Blue Economy and Marine Entrepreneurship Page 12 of 51 STRAND 1.0: FISH BIOLOGY  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Blue Economy and Marine Entrepreneurship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
